title: Page title
description: PageTitle is the large display title of a page (text only). PageTabsTitle turns it into 2–4 underline tabs for sibling pages.
when: The first line of every page (PageTitle).
2–4 sibling views of one area: Máy in / Job in (PageTabsTitle).

instead.need: Tabs inside a card or panel

a11y: PageTitle is the page h1. PageTabsTitle is a tablist with arrow-key navigation.
notes: No subtitle under the title and no text buttons on the title row: actions go to PageActions or the toolbar.
